## Verification evidence

- [ ] I ran the workflow in Harbor Meridian Systems using `Docs Demo` records.
- [ ] I tested with a normal customer role.
- [ ] I tested with the appropriate administrator role when required.
- [ ] I verified permissions, side effects, success messages, recovery, and cleanup.
- [ ] I ran `npm run check` and the rendered ReadMe Docs Audit.
- [ ] Priority customer wording returns this page in the first three search results.

## Media and public-data safety

- [ ] Screenshots are current full-width PNG files, 1500–2200 pixels wide and 500 KB or less, with useful alt text.
- [ ] Every screenshot-capable workflow action has a visual beside the relevant step, and no screenshot appears after **Get help**.
- [ ] Screenshots and recordings show only approved, sanitized Harbor Meridian Systems data.
- [ ] Browser profiles, unrelated tabs, emails, notifications, account menus, internal URLs, identifiers, payment details, credentials, tokens, and secrets are not visible.
- [ ] The first-release product navigation is active; no release-excluded area is central to a capture.
- [ ] Every changed clip is 1–3 minutes, captioned, and has a matching transcript in `recordings/`.
- [ ] Written instructions remain complete without the media.

## Approval and publishing

- [ ] Product approved behavioral accuracy and UI labels.
- [ ] Support approved clarity, diagnostic value, and escalation guidance.
- [ ] `release-status` is `ready`, with no pending verification metadata.
- [ ] Ask AI remains disabled unless the separate 90% citation-supported benchmark gate passed.
- [ ] API Reference is unchanged, or its separately reviewed change is explained below.
- [ ] The complete diff contains no planning, agent-instruction, handoff, or status Markdown.
- [ ] The complete diff contains no credentials, customer data, private URLs, internal architecture, source code, or trade secrets.

## Reviewer notes

Record Product and Support decisions, known limitations, and any follow-up that must remain on an unpublished branch.
